dse_strategy.notes: Evaluate the OpenROAD default anchor first, spend the remaining deterministic anchors on mechanism-shaped coverage, spend the startup budget on broad mixed discrete/continuous exploration, then exploit promising parameter regions with parallel-aware TPE.

score.best_json: best.json is HPWL-best only; best_value.json is G_HR-best for analysis only.
score.gain_formula: G_HR = 100*(HPWL_ref - HPWL_sol)/HPWL_ref - P(runtime_sol/runtime_ref); P(r)=0 when r<=runtime_deadband_ratio, otherwise runtime_penalty_at_2x*(sqrt(r)-sqrt(runtime_deadband_ratio))/(sqrt(2)-sqrt(runtime_deadband_ratio))
score.runtime_break_even: Runtime speedups and <=deadband runtime noise receive no bonus; 2x runtime requires runtime_penalty_at_2x reference-normalized final-HPWL percentage points of improvement to be value-positive. This does not replace raw HPWL as the BO objective.
